About Verso Verso is a residential development by Reportage Properties in Bukadra, forming part of the wider Meydan Horizon district. The project brings together apartments and ground-level retail within a building organised across two basement levels, a ground floor, two podium levels and 15 residential floors. The residential collection comprises one-, two- and four-bedroom apartments, with published layouts starting at approximately 505 sq. ft. The range is relatively focused, moving from more compact one-bedroom homes to larger four-bedroom residences. The design includes private balconies and terraces, with built-in wardrobes, fully tiled bathrooms, and contemporary kitchen cabinetry and countertops. Large windows, double-glazed glazing and fibre-optic connectivity are among the documented features of the residences. The interiors use a contemporary approach with practical finishes and a neutral palette, keeping the emphasis on straightforward, functional living rather than elaborate detailing. The amenity programme focuses on outdoor recreation, fitness, and family use. A main swimming pool and pool deck sit alongside a children's pool and splash zone, while a padel court, gym and yoga area provide dedicated spaces for exercise. Landscaped areas and shaded seating create quieter outdoor spaces, complemented by children's play facilities and recreational areas including foosball and table tennis. The development's location is a defining characteristic. Bukadra sits within the wider Meydan area, placing Verso within reach of Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall, Dubai Design District, Dubai Creek Harbour and Meydan Racecourse. Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary is also nearby, providing a contrasting natural landscape to the increasingly urban surroundings. Verso is therefore positioned around a relatively simple residential proposition: contemporary apartments, a practical amenity programme, and access to several established Dubai destinations, within a district that continues to develop. description: Reference: YHKN-T13221. Eywa is an exclusive luxury residential development located along the Dubai Canal in the prestigious district of Business Bay. Inspired by the symbolism of the Tree of Life, the project combines high end architecture with a lifestyle concept focused on wellness, balance, and connection with nature. The building offers a limited collection of just 50 waterfront residences and two ultra luxury penthouses. Apartments range from spacious two to five bedroom layouts, with living areas from approximately 3,064 to over 16,000 square feet. Each residence is designed to maximize natural light and views, featuring expansive terraces, floor to ceiling windows, and natural elements that create a calm and harmonious living environment. The architecture draws inspiration from the organic structure of a banyan tree, with flowing forms and natural materials that give the building its distinctive appearance. Many residences include private pools, waterfalls, and lush greenery, creating a unique indoor outdoor living experience rarely found in city developments. A key element of the project is its focus on holistic well being. Residents have access to a wide range of wellness focused facilities including a luxury spa, yoga and meditation spaces, fitness studio, crystal gardens, and relaxation areas. A distinctive feature of the building is a crystal pyramid integrated within the structure, incorporating thousands of semi precious stones intended to promote positive energy and balance throughout the space. Eywa is also designed with sustainability and health conscious living in mind. The project aims to achieve both LEED Platinum and WELL Platinum certifications, reflecting high standards in energy efficiency, environmental responsibility, and indoor air and water quality. Natural materials such as wood, stone, and clay are used extensively to create warm, natural interiors while reducing environmental impact. Residents benefit from a wide selection of premium amenities including swimming pools, a wellness spa with hammam and sauna, beauty salon, cinema lounge, library, clubhouse dining spaces, and children's activity areas. Additional lifestyle services provide concierge assistance, wellness programs, housekeeping, and other tailored services designed to enhance everyday living. Situated along the scenic Dubai Canal and just minutes from iconic landmarks such as Dubai Fountain, the development offers a peaceful waterfront setting while remaining close to Dubai's major business, shopping, and entertainment destinations. Combining innovative architecture, sustainability, and a wellness driven lifestyle concept, Eywa represents a new standard of luxury living in Dubai where modern comfort meets harmony with nature. title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

description: Exclusive Waterfront Apartments with Wynn Casino Views in Ras Al Khaimah Ras Al Khaimah, the northernmost emirate of the UAE, is renowned for its stunning coastline, majestic mountains, and rapidly growing luxury real estate market. This dynamic destination blends rich cultural heritage with modern infrastructure, offering residents and investors a high-quality lifestyle. One of the most anticipated developments in the region is the Wynn Al Marjan Island, the UAE's first integrated gaming and resort destination. Set to open in 2027, this mega-project will feature a world-class casino, luxury hotels, fine dining, and entertainment experiences, making Ras Al Khaimah a premier global tourism and investment hub. With its breathtaking waterfront views, expanding infrastructure, and promising economic growth, Ras Al Khaimah is quickly becoming one of the most sought-after locations in the UAE for luxury living and investment opportunities. are conveniently located just 3 minutes from Al Hamra Mall, 6 minutes from Al Marjan Island Beach and Al Hamra Marina & Yacht Club, 13 minutes from Ras Al Khaimah Corniche, 15 minutes from Wynn Casino, 25 minutes from Ras Al Khaimah International Airport, 45 minutes from Dubai International Airport, and 55 minutes from Downtown Dubai. Designed as an exclusive waterfront community, this development seamlessly blends modern luxury with natural tranquility. It features five elegant 18-story towers, each offering breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf and the iconic Wynn Al Marjan Island. Inspired by traditional Arabic architecture, the exteriors combine earthy tones and contemporary design, creating a visually striking yet serene environment. Residents can enjoy direct sea access and an extensive array of world-class amenities, including a scenic promenade, state-of-the-art fitness center, coworking spaces, an entertainment room, multiple swimming pools, a kids' play area, jogging tracks, and championship padel tennis courts. For outdoor enthusiasts, lush parks, a dedicated pet-friendly zone with grooming services, and barbecue areas enhance the community's appeal. The development is further enriched by its proximity to the Royal Yacht Club, Al Hamra Golf Club, and an array of luxury hotels, fine dining, and high-end retail outlets, ensuring a sophisticated yet relaxed lifestyle. The project offers a meticulously designed collection of residences, including spacious 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, each crafted for modern comfort and elegance. Interiors are thoughtfully planned with open layouts that maximize natural light, featuring floor-to-ceiling windows that frame stunning sea views. High-quality finishes and premium materials create a sophisticated ambiance, complemented by neutral, earthy tones inspired by the surrounding landscape. Each residence is equipped with fitted wardrobes, ensuring ample storage space, and a fully integrated kitchen with high-end white goods, blending convenience with contemporary aesthetics. The living and dining areas flow seamlessly onto private balconies, offering breathtaking vistas of the Arabian Gulf. The master bedrooms are designed as serene retreats, with en-suite bathrooms featuring sleek fixtures and refined detailing. Smart home technology and energy-efficient features enhance everyday living, while spacious layouts cater to both relaxation and entertainment, creating an unparalleled waterfront lifestyle. description: Furnished Apartments with Burj Khalifa Views in Business Bay, Dubai Business Bay is a vibrant and upscale district in the heart of Dubai, known for its dynamic mix of luxury residential towers, high-end hotels, and premium office spaces. Strategically located along the Dubai Canal, it offers breathtaking skyline views, including the iconic Burj Khalifa. The area is a hub for business, leisure, and lifestyle, featuring world-class dining, shopping, and entertainment options. With excellent connectivity via major highways and the metro, Business Bay attracts professionals, investors, and residents seeking a modern urban lifestyle with easy access to Downtown Dubai and other key destinations. are strategically located with access to Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Khail Road, Al-A'amal Street, and Al Asayel Street. The apartments are just 4 minutes from Business Bay Metro Station, 5 minutes from Marasi Promenade, 9 minutes from Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, 10 minutes from The Dubai Fountain, 11 minutes from Dubai Opera and Museum of The Future, 14 minutes from Coca-Cola arena, 16 minutes from Dubai International Airport, 24 minutes from Jumeirah Beach Residence and Dubai Marina, 35 minutes from Al Maktoum International Airport. The project offers a modern and sophisticated living experience with an extensive array of luxurious amenities designed to enhance comfort and convenience. The exterior features a sleek, contemporary design with stunning views of the Dubai skyline. The building is equipped with an infinity pool, Jacuzzi, kids' pool, aquatic gym, and pool deck seating, complemented by a BBQ area, kids' play area, and a variety of sports facilities including a cricket pitch, trampoline arena, wall climbing, basketball court, and tennis/cricket training courts. A wellness club, beauty salon, kids' daycare, snooker zone, and library provide additional comfort and relaxation. The upper levels boast exclusive amenities such as a sky observatory deck, sky meditation area, and both indoor and outdoor party halls, with a rooftop featuring a golf simulator, arcade zone, and family seating. The development also includes a business centre, indoor gyms, jogging track, bowling center, and outdoor cinema, ensuring a well-rounded lifestyle for its residents. The project features fully furnished 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, each designed to offer a luxurious and contemporary living experience. The interiors are carefully curated with high-end finishes and attention to detail. The living spaces are spacious, with open layouts that seamlessly connect the living room, dining area, and kitchen, creating a perfect environment for relaxation and entertainment. Each apartment is equipped with fitted wardrobes in the bedrooms and kitchen white goods, including a refrigerator, cooker, and washing machine, ensuring ease and functionality. The modern kitchens are designed with sleek cabinetry and high-quality materials for a sophisticated look. Additionally, the apartments offer the option of private pools on the balcony, giving residents the opportunity to enjoy stunning views while experiencing the ultimate in privacy and luxury. The bathrooms are designed with premium fixtures and finishes, further elevating the overall living experience. With every detail meticulously planned, these apartments provide the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and style for those looking to live in the heart of Dubai's vibrant Business Bay. title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. description: This is not a two-bedroom apartment with a generous balcony. It is a 3,302.26 sq ft (306.79 m²) private-pool residence whose outdoor space is larger than its entire interior. Set on the seventh floor of Aqua Arc, the corner plan combines sea and internal-landscape views with a remarkable 2,099.39 sq ft private terrace and an asking price of AED 8,558,998. The pool belongs to the residence and occupies the outer arc of the terrace. It is not several floors away within a shared amenity deck. That single distinction changes how the home can be used: the outdoor space becomes a private setting for quiet mornings, open-air dining and evenings hosted above Al Marjan Island. Inside, the 1,202.87 sq ft (111.75 m²) suite is planned as a complete two-bedroom home. The entrance creates a clear transition into the living areas, with a 2.0 by 2.5 metre kitchen connecting naturally to the 4.6 by 5.2 metre living and dining room. The curved frontage draws the eye toward the terrace, allowing the interior to remain visually connected with the pool and the changing outlook beyond it. The private accommodation sits away from the main social space. The principal bedroom measures 3.8 by 4.2 metres and is paired with a substantial 2.8 by 3.6 metre bathroom. The second bedroom measures 3.3 by 4.2 metres and is served by another full bathroom. A separate powder room keeps guest use away from the bedroom accommodation, while a dedicated laundry preserves the kitchen as part of the home's entertaining space. The terrace is the defining room. At approximately 195.04 m², it offers enough breadth to compose several outdoor zones instead of forcing every activity into one arrangement. There is scope for dining near the living room, a more relaxed lounge along the curved frontage and sun loungers beside the private pool. These are potential uses rather than included furnishings, but the physical proportions make each possible without compromising circulation. The seventh-floor corner position gives the residence two distinct outlooks. One aspect turns toward the sea; the other takes in Aqua Arc's internal landscape. The view therefore develops as one moves around the terrace rather than presenting a single fixed elevation. title: Dubayy, Dubai
description: Reference: YHKN-T13217. Eywa is an exclusive luxury residential development located along the Dubai Canal in the prestigious district of Business Bay. Inspired by the symbolism of the Tree of Life, the project combines high end architecture with a lifestyle concept focused on wellness, balance, and connection with nature. The building offers a limited collection of just 50 waterfront residences and two ultra luxury penthouses. Apartments range from spacious two to five bedroom layouts, with living areas from approximately 3,064 to over 16,000 square feet. Each residence is designed to maximize natural light and views, featuring expansive terraces, floor to ceiling windows, and natural elements that create a calm and harmonious living environment. The architecture draws inspiration from the organic structure of a banyan tree, with flowing forms and natural materials that give the building its distinctive appearance. Many residences include private pools, waterfalls, and lush greenery, creating a unique indoor outdoor living experience rarely found in city developments. A key element of the project is its focus on holistic well being. Residents have access to a wide range of wellness focused facilities including a luxury spa, yoga and meditation spaces, fitness studio, crystal gardens, and relaxation areas. A distinctive feature of the building is a crystal pyramid integrated within the structure, incorporating thousands of semi precious stones intended to promote positive energy and balance throughout the space. Eywa is also designed with sustainability and health conscious living in mind. The project aims to achieve both LEED Platinum and WELL Platinum certifications, reflecting high standards in energy efficiency, environmental responsibility, and indoor air and water quality. Natural materials such as wood, stone, and clay are used extensively to create warm, natural interiors while reducing environmental impact. Residents benefit from a wide selection of premium amenities including swimming pools, a wellness spa with hammam and sauna, beauty salon, cinema lounge, library, clubhouse dining spaces, and children's activity areas. Additional lifestyle services provide concierge assistance, wellness programs, housekeeping, and other tailored services designed to enhance everyday living. Situated along the scenic Dubai Canal and just minutes from iconic landmarks such as Dubai Fountain, the development offers a peaceful waterfront setting while remaining close to Dubai's major business, shopping, and entertainment destinations. Combining innovative architecture, sustainability, and a wellness driven lifestyle concept, Eywa represents a new standard of luxury living in Dubai where modern comfort meets harmony with nature. title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

description: The Arabian Gulf does not offer this view to everyone. At Samana Ocean Crest, it comes with your morning coffee. Fifty-six residences. One island. No compromise. Developed by Samana Developers - ranked fifth among Dubai's highest off-plan sellers by volume in the first half of 2025, with a portfolio valued at over AED 17 billion - Ocean Crest represents the developer's most considered coastal statement to date. Positioned on Dubai Islands, the Nakheel-masterplanned destination that redefines what island living means in this city, the project rises across eight residential floors with a discipline of scale that most developers would not allow themselves: just 56 residences, each one crafted with the attention that only boutique numbers permit. Many homes feature private terrace pools, interiors finished in warm natural stone, wood, and glass, and layouts calibrated around panoramic sea and skyline perspectives. Samana has built its reputation on delivering resort-style living as a lived experience rather than a marketing promise - and Ocean Crest is where that philosophy meets the Gulf itself. THE EXPERIENCE: Life at Ocean Crest operates at the cadence of the sea. Mornings open to the Arabian Gulf with no obstruction, afternoons unfold across a resort-grade amenity landscape, and evenings carry the particular stillness that only island addresses can offer. This is not urban living softened by a view. It is coastal living, fully committed. Private terrace pools - select residences with direct pool access from your own outdoor space Infinity pool and sun deck - a skyline-facing water environment designed for unhurried days Yoga studios and wellness spaces - dedicated areas for restoration alongside the water's edge Spa, sauna, and steam rooms - a full wellness facility integrated into the building's daily rhythm Children's splash pad and family zones - thoughtfully separated spaces for every generation Landscaped gardens and jogging tracks - green corridors woven into the island environment 24/7 concierge and artistic lobby - a resident arrival experience that sets the register from the first step THE INVESTMENT CASE: Dubai Islands is one of the few remaining large-scale waterfront destinations in Dubai where early capital allocation still carries meaningful upside - a Nakheel-developed master community with confirmed infrastructure, beach access, and a pipeline of hospitality and retail that will anchor long-term demand. Ocean Crest's boutique scale of 56 residences operates as a natural scarcity lever in a market where oversupply is the persistent structural risk. Samana's 86% foreign investor demand ratio confirms the international conviction behind the developer's product - and a freehold title on a beachfront island address, at a confirmed entry point of AED 2.2M, positions this well within reach of the buyer profile that this location will continue to attract. With handover in Q3 2028 and a 20/70/10 payment plan, the capital deployment is structured to carry investors through the community's most active development phase. WHO THIS IS FOR: This is for those who have spent enough time in landlocked buildings and have decided, with some finality, that the water is non-negotiable. People who want their Dubai address to signal something more specific than premium - something coastal, considered, and genuinely rare at this scale. Buyers who understand the arithmetic of boutique beachfront freehold on an emerging island master plan, and who also simply want to swim in their own pool on a Tuesday morning with nothing but the Gulf in front of them. Ocean Crest. Fifty-six chances to own the edge of the island.

description: Beachfront Apartments with Installments on Siniyah Island, Umm Al-Quwain Siniyah Island in Umm Al-Quwain is a stunning haven that blends luxurious living with breathtaking natural surroundings. This exclusive community offers a range of upscale residences, including waterfront villas and elegant apartments, thoughtfully crafted for a sophisticated island lifestyle. Residents benefit from direct beach access, expansive green spaces, and world-class amenities such as an 18-hole golf course, eco-park, and water sports adventures. With its rich ecological diversity and cultural heritage, Siniyah Island provides a peaceful escape just 50 minutes from Dubai, perfectly balancing tranquility and urban convenience. Umm Al Quwain are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project offers a luxurious lifestyle harmoniously integrated with natural beauty, featuring state-of-the-art residential units within multi-use towers ranging from 2 to 10 stories. The development is surrounded by pristine white sand beaches, lush mangroves, and a rich tapestry of unique wildlife. Community amenities include a recreational fishing deck, family-oriented golf course, event cabanas, al fresco dining, and luxury beach cabanas. A seawater lagoon is central to the community, providing facilities for non-motorized water sports such as snorkeling, paddleboarding, kayaking, and floating cinema experiences. Linear parks are equipped with yoga decks, wellness parks, and sports facilities like tennis and paddle courts, alongside skateboarding zones. Additional highlights include a yacht club, mosque, retail mall, public beach, and helicopter landing pad. Residents can enjoy a clubhouse with a gym, library lounge, steam and sauna rooms, and multipurpose spaces. The development also prioritizes sustainability with double-glazed façades, energy-efficient systems, and provisions for electric vehicle charging. The project features meticulously designed interiors that combine elegance with functionality, offering 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments with spacious layouts and high-quality finishes. Each unit is equipped with fitted wardrobes and kitchens that include premium white goods such as an oven, gas hob and hood, refrigerator, and washing machine. The living and bedroom areas are adorned with porcelain tile flooring and finished with matte emulsion paint walls for a sleek yet cozy ambiance. The master bedrooms boast en-suite bathrooms, while all bathrooms and powder rooms are outfitted with premium-brand water closets, washbasins, and chrome-plated fittings. Kitchens feature high-quality reconstituted stone countertops and laminate or high-gloss PET-finished cabinets. Archaeological excavations have uncovered the oldest known pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf on the island, dating back to the late 6th or early 7th century CE. description: Reference: GTWW-T1354. The project is located in Business Bay, Dubai, next to the city's water canal, in a privileged location that offers easy access to the city's business, commerce and leisure centres. The architecture is built in three high-rise residential towers 48 floors with a contemporary design and typology designed for those looking to live in the urban heart, but with all the comforts of a modern development. The residential typologies cover a variety adapted to different lifestyles: studios, 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments. In addition, commercial shops, restaurants and retail options are planned on the ground floor and podium floors, which ensures convenience for residents and reduces the need to travel for daily services and shopping. The immediate proximity to the canal and the urban centre allows you to combine the tranquillity of a water zone with the energy of the city, ideal for those looking for a balance between modern living, comfort and accessibility. Taken together, this development represents a high-end residential proposal combining contemporary architecture, flexible typologies ranging from the studio to the 3-bedroom flat, sophisticated finishes, privileged views and a set of amenities that guarantee comfort, safety and quality of life. description:
Pier Point is a waterfront residential development by Emaar Properties, located within Rashid Yachts & Marina at Mina Rashid, Dubai. description: Elegant Flats with Resort-Style Amenities in Ras Al Khaimah Downtown Mina in Ras Al Khaimah represents a beautiful fusion of vibrant urban activity and serene coastal tranquility. Once defined by 18 kilometers of pristine shoreline, this premium island has evolved into a highly desirable residential destination shaped by connections, design, and light. Seamlessly linking a vibrant pedestrian boulevard, lush landscaped parks, and a world-class marina, it offers an exclusive lifestyle where city pace meets island calm. Residents are surrounded by beautiful natural mangroves filled with native wildlife, with the steady backdrop of the Hajar Mountains. The are situated just a 10-minute drive away from the highly anticipated Wynn Casino and only 15 minutes from the iconic Al Marjan Island. Travel is effortless with Ras Al Khaimah International Airport reachable within 15 to 20 minutes. Furthermore, Dubai International Airport (DXB) is a smooth 45 to 60-minute drive, and Zayed International Airport in Abu Dhabi is accessible in 125 minutes. The residential complex features an outstanding collection of outdoor and indoor amenities designed for health, recreation, and social connection. Outdoors, residents can enjoy a 25-meter main lap pool, a kid's splash area, a jogging track, and an outdoor fitness gym. The beautifully landscaped gardens also include a padel court, a mini-golf course, a skate park, and a dedicated pet park. Indoors, the double-height grand lobby welcomes you to a multipurpose clubhouse, co-working spaces, a premium yoga studio, and a curated art gallery. Every flat is beautifully designed, starting from compact studios up to spectacular four-bedroom penthouses, offering breathtaking views. Built with smart home automation for lighting and climate control, the residences offer peak modern convenience. Sustainability is prioritized through energy-saving LED fixtures and high-efficiency VRF HVAC technology. The interiors showcase premium craftsmanship, high-quality finishes, and expansive double-glazed thermal windows that frame the sea, park, or marina, providing an abundance of natural light. description: One of the Final Opportunities at DG1 Living Positioned on the 13th floor of the striking DG1 Living, this 126 m² corner apartment presents one of the final opportunities to own a two-bedroom residence within one of Business Bay's most recognisable new developments. Designed by internationally acclaimed architectural firm Gensler and developed by DarGlobal, DG1 combines sculptural architecture with a prime waterfront address beside the Dubai Canal, creating a landmark residential tower in the heart of Dubai. Although the tower enjoys a prestigious canal-side location, this particular residence benefits from an open city outlook, offering expansive urban views across Business Bay together with abundant natural light throughout the day. As one of only two remaining two-bedroom apartments currently available within the project, it represents an increasingly rare opportunity for buyers seeking a premium freehold property before completion. The Residence Every element of this apartment has been designed to maximise comfort, light and functionality. The generous 126 m² layout centres around a spacious open-plan living and dining area that connects seamlessly to the private balcony, creating an effortless transition between indoor and outdoor living. Large floor-to-ceiling windows frame the surrounding cityscape while filling the interiors with natural daylight from multiple directions thanks to the apartment's desirable corner position. The contemporary kitchen integrates naturally with the living spaces, allowing the apartment to function equally well as a permanent residence, a second home or an investment property. Both bedrooms provide generous proportions, built-in storage and privacy, while premium materials and refined finishes reinforce the project's luxury positioning. Unlike many developments where every apartment follows an identical template, the corner configuration provides a noticeably brighter environment and a greater feeling of openness throughout the home. Landmark Architecture by Gensler DG1 Living has become one of the most distinctive additions to the Business Bay skyline. Rather than relying on conventional straight-line architecture, the building features flowing terraces and sculpted balconies that create movement throughout the façade. Designed by Gensler, one of the world's leading architectural firms, the tower has been conceived as a contemporary landmark overlooking the Dubai Canal. Its bold architectural identity distinguishes DG1 from many neighbouring residential developments while providing residents with elegant communal areas and thoughtfully planned living spaces. Living in Business Bay Business Bay has evolved into one of Dubai's most desirable mixed-use districts, combining residential, commercial and leisure facilities within a central location. Residents enjoy convenient access to: Dubai Canal Downtown Dubai Burj Khalifa Dubai Mall Dubai Opera DIFC Sheikh Zayed Road Al Khail Road This strategic position makes the apartment equally attractive for professionals working in central Dubai, international buyers seeking a second residence and investors looking for long-term capital appreciation. To better understand the market, explore our guides to Invest in Dubai Real Estate, Invest in UAE Real Estate, Understanding International Real Estate Investment, and the complete DG1 Living Freehold Apartments Dubai project page. Long stays: undergraduates usually stay 3-4 years, and 75-85% renew Parents back the lease: 80%+ of international student leases carry a parental guarantee Fewer missed payments: 2-4% default or late payment, against 8-12% for young professionals Staff and faculty tenants: 2-3 year contracts give income all year round Handling the summer gap: Start leases in September, line up next year's tenants in March-April, and allow summer sublets. description: The development features an exclusive collection of penthouses located on the highest levels, designed to offer a refined lifestyle, panoramic views and an unparalleled residential experience. Located by the sea and integrated in one of the most prestigious points of Dubai Harbour, the development is distinguished by its contemporary architecture, sophisticated interiors and a selection of rare and wide typologies. Within this same development, there is this 3 bedroom flat overlooking the sea, offering a spacious and sophisticated residential experience. This 3 bedroom unit combines the functionality of three bedrooms with high-end finishes, balconies that enhance the view and access to all the exclusive amenities of the condominium, providing comfort, practicality and a premium lifestyle next to the Marina. The five-bedroom penthouses, spread across levels 60 and 61, offer 180-degree views that span Palm Jumeirah, Bluewaters, Ain Dubai, Jbr Beach, Marina Skyline, Dubai Harbour and the open sea. These units have large living and lounge rooms, large dining room, main kitchen and kitchen, private office, home cinema, gym, pool on the balcony, bedrooms with walk-in closet, full service areas and generous balconies that enhance the view and natural light. The total areas of the units vary between about 724.65m² and 799m², including balconies and outdoor storage spaces. The units located on the 60th and 61st floors have the same typology, distinguished mainly by the small variations in indoor and outdoor areas, always maintaining large suites, spacious living areas and privileged views over the sea and the city. Units 6002 and 6102, also with five bedrooms, offer a similar configuration, with subtle differences in the size of the main rooms and leisure spaces, preserving the same level of finish and comfort characteristic of the development. On level 62 is a six-bedroom penthouse with 360-degree views over the entire city. This unit features two master suites with walk-in closet and spa-type bathrooms, cinema room, gym, sauna, hammam, wine room, bar, several living and dining rooms, three separate kitchens, private office, safe room, additional bedrooms with private bathrooms, full service area and multiple storage spaces. With more than 1840m² in total, it represents one of the most imposing and exclusive units of the development. On level 63 is another six-bedroom penthouse, with a similar but even wider layout, with total areas exceeding 1840m². This unit also enjoys completely unobstructed views, multiple social environments, spacious suites, technical and service areas, as well as generous outdoor spaces, designed to provide privacy, comfort and elegance. The finishes present in all units reflect the high standard of the development. The bathrooms include smart toilets and equipment from well-known brands, with premium finish furniture. The kitchens are fully equipped with high-performance appliances, cabinetry in durable materials and double sink. The development also offers several exclusive amenities, such as private outdoor cabanas, Bbq areas, outdoor living areas, leisure spaces and wellness environments integrated into carefully designed green areas. The development redefines the concept of seaside living in Dubai Harbour, combining spaciousness, privacy, excellent finishes and extraordinary views, offering a residential experience of true distinction both in the luxury penthouses and in this 3-bedroom flat with sea views, ideal for those looking for comfort, exclusivity and sophistication.
